Only the account bound when enabled is monitored. To change accounts, disable, switch accounts, then enable. Literal matching ignores English letter case. Muted and archived chats are included. No history scanning or extra background service. Notifications obey Android permission and channel settings.

Nullgram is independently modified from Niagram (formerly NiagramX), revision bc99e5e9907a2ea47d9e6ed432469b8ff553644f. Modified 2026-11-01. It is not an official release of Niagram, NagramX, Nagram, Nekogram or Telegram. Copyright and third-party notices are preserved. Source is licensed under GPLv3; matching complete source and build instructions accompany the APK distribution. The application ID is retained for compatibility; the Nullgram display name identifies this independent fork; launcher artwork retains its original attribution, with optional independent Nullgram icons.
Nullgram is a Telegram client mod.
